tasks.title: Specify WCAG 2.1 AA accessible color tokens and contrast matrix for IncidentLens
tasks.description: Formulate design tokens ensuring normal text and interactive button states achieve >= 4.5:1 contrast ratio against dark backgrounds.
tasks.objective: Deliver mathematically verified WCAG AA accessible token palette.
acceptance_criteria: Primary button token (--btn-primary-bg: #2563eb) provides >= 4.5:1 contrast against white text
Hover (#1d4ed8), active (#1e40af), and focus (#60a5fa) states maintain high contrast
Canvas and surface colors provide high-contrast background for text (#090d13 / #f0f6fc)

tasks.title: Establish responsive layout hierarchy and keyboard accessibility contract for IncidentLens
tasks.description: Define responsive grid, keyboard Tab order, 2px focus-visible outlines, and ARIA semantic labels for all interactive elements.
tasks.objective: Guarantee 100% keyboard accessibility and responsive adaptability.
acceptance_criteria: 2px focus outline specified for keyboard users
All form controls and buttons provide accessible names/labels
Responsive layout scales gracefully across screen sizes

accessibility_invariants: Every interactive control has an explicit aria-label or visible label
